beats.text: Pokémon Go did not just have a busy launch. It was planned for a tiny fraction of the traffic it got.
beats.note: The engineers targeted 1X, and treated about 5X as the worst case.

beats.name: Niantic
beats.role: Launched Pokémon Go on 6 July 2016 in Australia, New Zealand and the United States.

beats.context: The traffic it actually received compared with the original target, ten times the worst case estimate.

beats.text: The first launch region blew past the plan within 15 minutes.
beats.note: Google wrote that Australia and New Zealand exceeded expectations almost at once.

beats.text: It ran on Kubernetes at a scale Google had not seen before.
beats.note: Google called it the largest Kubernetes deployment on its container service at the time.

beats.text: The crashes were not a failure to plan. The plan was fifty times too small.

beats.line: Every big launch is a guess.
